ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Suspicious Winget Package Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential suspicious winget package installation from a suspicious source. Note: Unmapped fields: Contents

sequences.query: (Contents = RGX("^\\[ZoneTransfer\\]\\ \\ ZoneId\\=3") AND (Contents = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/1.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/2.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/3.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/4.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/5.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/6.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/7.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/8.*") OR Contents = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/9.*")) AND file_path = RGX("\\:Zone\\\.Identifier$") AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\WinGet\\\\.*"))
